title: Polynomial-time language defined by a length bound
statement: Let $f,g$ be polynomial-time computable functions from binary strings to binary strings, and let $C,c$ be natural numbers. Then the language of strings $z$ satisfying $|f(z)|\le C(|g(z)|+1)^c$ belongs to $\mathsf P$.
